title: All equipment fields
sql: SELECT * FROM Equipment ORDER BY EquipmentID;

title: Choose fields
sql: SELECT EquipmentID, EquipmentDescription FROM Equipment ORDER BY EquipmentID;

title: Camera items
sql: SELECT EquipmentID, EquipmentDescription FROM Equipment WHERE EquipmentDescription = 'Camera' ORDER BY EquipmentID;

title: Active loans
sql: SELECT LoanID, DueDate FROM Loan WHERE Returned = 0 ORDER BY DueDate ASC, LoanID ASC;

title: Overdue at 8 April
sql: SELECT LoanID, BorrowerID, DueDate FROM Loan WHERE Returned = 0 AND DueDate < '2026-04-08' ORDER BY DueDate ASC, LoanID ASC;

title: Audio or imaging items
sql: SELECT EquipmentID, CategoryID FROM Equipment WHERE CategoryID = 'C03' OR CategoryID = 'C01' ORDER BY EquipmentID;

title: Grouped conditions
sql: SELECT LoanID FROM Loan WHERE Returned = 0 AND (BorrowerID = 'B001' OR BorrowerID = 'B002') ORDER BY LoanID;

title: Distinct descriptions
sql: SELECT DISTINCT EquipmentDescription FROM Equipment ORDER BY EquipmentDescription;

title: Empty result
sql: SELECT EquipmentID FROM Equipment WHERE CategoryID = 'C99' ORDER BY EquipmentID;
